scope: Outbound HTTP SSRF and whitelist DNS, HTTP redirect deadline, web fetch preflight and browser fallback cancellation.

before.observed: Actual blocked net.DefaultResolver calls outlive cancellation in HTTP sink, CIDR dial whitelist, and web fetch preflight.
Browser fallback DNS cancellation/deadline becomes empty_content or http_403 for successful/forbidden initial HTTP responses.
Client.Timeout and earlier previous-response deadline do not bound CheckRedirect DNS.

fix: Context-aware compatibility wrappers preserve existing IP/hostname/whitelist policy.
Cancelable singleflight waiting; a canceled leader does not poison cache or terminate unrelated active callers.
Page timeout starts before preflight; proxy and pinned connections carry request context through CIDR lookups.
Redirect validator inherits only previous transport deadline; preserves earlier current deadline and ignores previous response cancellation.
Browser DNS and HTTP cancellation retain error causes and correct timeout/cancellation classification.

validation.result: Independent real local UDP DNS control: canceled leader plus four live waiters retains public-IP allow/restricted-IP deny decisions; repeated race passes.

intermediate_validation_note: Initial model consumer command included nonexistent ./internal/utils/ollama and returned setup failure; all actual model API/chat packages passed. Correct ./internal/models/utils/ollama was tested in final race gate.
limits: Legacy context-free entrypoints retain Background compatibility; unrelated project preflight callers are not claimed migrated.
No live external DNS or real Chromium end-to-end validation is claimed by the new fixtures. Existing package tests and deterministic HTTP/DNS fixtures exercised local boundaries.
This does not alter whitelist policy, production services or live user data.
